name: wm
description: WhiteMagic meta-tool — memory and continuity kernel over the curated tool surface. Invoke with thought=<natural language> (auto-routed), route=<exact tool id>, or args=<object> (passthrough). Say "list tools" to enumerate.

name: memory.create
description: Store a new memory in the holographic memory core.

name: memory.search
description: Search and recall memories using hybrid semantic, BM25, and associative retrieval.

name: memory.read
description: Retrieve a specific memory by ID.

name: memory.list
description: List memories with filters (galaxy, tags, limit, offset).

name: memory.hybrid_recall
description: Fused recall across full-text, vector, graph, and coordinate lookup.

name: session.start
description: Start or resume an agent session for persistent continuity.

name: session.record
description: Record a session turn (decision, breakthrough, summary).

name: session.continuity
description: Recall where the previous session left off.
